```blitzbasic
ImageWidth:Int32 image:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | In | Int32 | required | The image. |

**Returns:** The width of a frame.

## Description

The width of one frame of an image in pixels.
